claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, (S)-(-)-BAY K-8644 acts as a dihydropyridine L-type calcium channel agonist that promotes sustained Ca2+ influx and depolarization-mediated toxicity, but this is unlikely to produce a distinctive cancer-cell-line killing pattern and the compound is expected to be largely inactive or weakly cytostatic in the pooled viability screen.
